"""Headless tests for domain, content, and storage."""

from __future__ import annotations

from fractions import Fraction
import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from content import default_questions
from domain import (
    DECIMAL_TOLERANCE,
    Question,
    Session,
    check_answer,
    make_score_record,
    parse_answer,
)
from storage import SCHEMA_VERSION, Store


class ParseAnswerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_simple_fractions(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("3/4"), Fraction(3, 4))

    def test_negative_simple_fraction_preserves_sign(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("-3/4"), Fraction(-3, 4))

    def test_positive_sign_fraction(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("+1/2"), Fraction(1, 2))

    def test_integers(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("7"), Fraction(7, 1))

    def test_negative_integer_preserves_sign(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("-7"), Fraction(-7, 1))

    def test_mixed_numbers(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("2 1/2"), Fraction(5, 2))

    def test_negative_mixed_number_preserves_sign(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("-2 1/2"), Fraction(-5, 2))

    def test_decimals(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("0.75"), Fraction(3, 4))

    def test_negative_decimal_preserves_sign(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("-0.75"), Fraction(-3, 4))

    def test_leading_dot_decimal(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer(".5"), Fraction(1, 2))

    def test_trailing_dot_decimal(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("3."), Fraction(3, 1))

    def test_whitespace_tolerated(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_answer("  3/4  "), Fraction(3, 4))

    def test_zero_denominator_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_answer("1/0")

    def test_malformed_rejected(self):
        for text in ["", "abc", "1/2/3", "1..2", "--3", "3/4 5/6"]:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=text):
                parse_answer(text)

    def test_non_string_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_answer(5)


class CheckAnswerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_fraction(self):
        self.assertTrue(check_answer(Fraction(3, 4), "3/4"))

    def test_decimal_equivalent(self):
        self.assertTrue(check_answer(Fraction(3, 4), "0.75"))

    def test_negative_fraction(self):
        self.assertTrue(check_answer(Fraction(-3, 4), "-3/4"))

    def test_tolerance_lower_bound(self):
        self.assertTrue(check_answer(Fraction(1, 3), "0.333333333"))

    def test_tolerance_upper_bound(self):
        self.assertTrue(check_answer(Fraction(1, 3), "0.333333334"))

    def test_tolerance_just_below(self):
        self.assertFalse(check_answer(Fraction(1, 3), "0.333333332"))

    def test_tolerance_just_above(self):
        self.assertFalse(check_answer(Fraction(1, 3), "0.333333335"))

    def test_malformed_returns_false(self):
        self.assertFalse(check_answer(Fraction(1, 2), "not a number"))


class DefaultQuestionsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_at_least_twenty_unique(self):
        questions = default_questions()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(questions), 20)
        ids = [q.id for q in questions]
        self.assertEqual(len(ids), len(set(ids)), "IDs must be unique")
        prompts = [q.prompt for q in questions]
        self.assertEqual(len(prompts), len(set(prompts)), "Prompts must be unique")

    def test_all_answers_parse_and_check(self):
        for question in default_questions():
            with self.subTest(question=question.id):
                parsed = parse_answer(str(question.answer))
                self.assertEqual(parsed, question.answer)
                self.assertTrue(check_answer(question.answer, str(question.answer)))

    def test_four_operations_present(self):
        prompts = [q.prompt for q in default_questions()]
        self.assertTrue(any("+" in p for p in prompts), "Addition missing")
        self.assertTrue(any("-" in p for p in prompts), "Subtraction missing")
        self.assertTrue(any("×" in p for p in prompts), "Multiplication missing")
        self.assertTrue(any("÷" in p for p in prompts), "Division missing")

    def test_negatives_present(self):
        prompts = [q.prompt for q in default_questions()]
        self.assertTrue(any(p.lstrip().startswith("-") for p in prompts))

    def test_mixed_numbers_present(self):
        prompts = [q.prompt for q in default_questions()]
        self.assertTrue(any(" " in p.split("=")[0] and "/" in p for p in prompts))

    def test_all_have_explanations(self):
        for question in default_questions():
            self.assertTrue(question.explanation, f"{question.id} missing explanation")

    def test_answers_are_fractions(self):
        for question in default_questions():
            self.assertIsInstance(question.answer, Fraction)


class SessionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.questions = [
            Question("q1", "1/2 + 1/4 = ?", Fraction(3, 4), "Common denominator"),
            Question("q2", "3/4 - 1/4 = ?", Fraction(1, 2), "Subtract"),
        ]
        self.session = Session(self.questions)

    def test_empty_session_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            Session([])

    def test_current_starts_at_first(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.session.current(), self.questions[0])

    def test_submit_correct(self):
        correct, message = self.session.submit("3/4")
        self.assertTrue(correct)
        self.assertIn("Correct", message)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.correct, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.attempted, 1)
        self.assertTrue(self.session.answered)

    def test_submit_wrong_number(self):
        correct, message = self.session.submit("1/2")
        self.assertFalse(correct)
        self.assertIn("Incorrect", message)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.correct, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.attempted, 1)

    def test_malformed_does_not_consume_attempt(self):
        correct, message = self.session.submit("abc")
        self.assertFalse(correct)
        self.assertIn("Malformed", message)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.attempted, 0)
        self.assertFalse(self.session.answered)

    def test_repeated_submit_prevented(self):
        self.session.submit("3/4")
        with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
            pass
        correct, message = self.session.submit("1/2")
        self.assertFalse(correct)
        self.assertIn("already answered", message)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.attempted, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.session.correct, 1)

    def test_next_requires_submission(self):
        self.assertIsNone(self.session.next())
        self.assertEqual(self.session.index, 0)

    def test_next_advances_once(self):
        self.session.submit("3/4")
        self.assertEqual(self.session.next(), self.questions[1])
        self.assertEqual(self.session.index, 1)
        self.assertFalse(self.session.answered)

    def test_next_finishes_after_last(self):
        self.session.submit("3/4")
        self.session.next()
        self.session.submit("1/2")
        self.assertIsNone(self.session.next())
        self.assertTrue(self.session.finished)
        self.assertIsNone(self.session.current())

    def test_accuracy_zero_before_attempts(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.session.accuracy, 0)

    def test_accuracy_after_one_correct(self):
        self.session.submit("3/4")
        self.assertEqual(self.session.accuracy, 100)

    def test_accuracy_after_one_wrong(self):
        self.session.submit("1/2")
        self.assertEqual(self.session.accuracy, 0)

    def test_accuracy_after_mixed(self):
        self.session.submit("3/4")
        self.session.next()
        self.session.submit("1/4")
        self.assertEqual(self.session.accuracy, 50)

    def test_submit_uses_check_answer(self):
        question = Question("q", "1/3 = ?", Fraction(1, 3), "")
        session = Session([question])
        self.assertTrue(session.submit("0.333333334")[0])


class ScoreRecordTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_score_record_fields(self):
        session = Session([Question("q", "1/2 = ?", Fraction(1, 2), "")])
        session.submit("1/2")
        record = make_score_record(session)
        self.assertIn("id", record)
        self.assertIsInstance(record["id"], str)
        self.assertEqual(record["correct"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(record["total"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(record["accuracy"], 100)
        self.assertIn("timestamp", record)
        self.assertIsInstance(record["timestamp"], str)

    def test_two_records_have_distinct_ids(self):
        session1 = Session([Question("q", "1/2 = ?", Fraction(1, 2), "")])
        session1.submit("1/2")
        session2 = Session([Question("q", "1/2 = ?", Fraction(1, 2), "")])
        session2.submit("1/2")
        record1 = make_score_record(session1)
        record2 = make_score_record(session2)
        self.assertNotEqual(record1["id"], record2["id"])


class StorageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.data_dir = Path(self.temp_dir.name)
        self.store = Store(self.data_dir)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def test_load_questions_seeds_defaults(self):
        questions = self.store.load_questions()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(questions), 20)
        self.assertTrue(self.store.questions_path.exists())

    def test_save_and_load_questions_roundtrip(self):
        questions = [
            Question("custom1", "1/3 + 1/3 = ?", Fraction(2, 3), "Add"),
            Question("custom2", "-1/2 - 1/4 = ?", Fraction(-3, 4), "Subtract"),
        ]
        self.store.save_questions(questions)
        loaded = self.store.load_questions()
        self.assertEqual(len(loaded), 2)
        self.assertEqual(loaded[0].id, "custom1")
        self.assertEqual(loaded[0].answer, Fraction(2, 3))
        self.assertEqual(loaded[1].answer, Fraction(-3, 4))

    def test_load_questions_recovers_corrupt(self):
        self.store.questions_path.write_text("{invalid json", encoding="utf-8")
        questions = self.store.load_questions()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(questions), 20)
        self.assertTrue(
            (self.data_dir / "questions.json.corrupt").exists()
            or not self.store.questions_path.exists()
        )

    def test_load_questions_recovers_invalid_schema(self):
        self.store.questions_path.write_text(
            json.dumps({"schema_version": 999, "questions": []}),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        questions = self.store.load_questions()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(questions), 20)

    def test_load_questions_recovers_empty(self):
        self.store.questions_path.write_text(
            json.dumps({"schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "questions": []}),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        questions = self.store.load_questions()
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(questions), 20)

    def test_save_questions_atomic_with_schema(self):
        self.store.save_questions(default_questions())
        raw = json.loads(self.store.questions_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        self.assertEqual(raw["schema_version"], SCHEMA_VERSION)
        self.assertIsInstance(raw["questions"], list)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(raw["questions"]), 20)

    def test_load_scores_empty_when_missing(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.store.load_scores(), [])

    def test_save_and_load_score(self):
        record = {
            "id": "test-id-1",
            "correct": 7,
            "total": 10,
            "accuracy": 70,
            "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        }
        self.store.save_score(record)
        scores = self.store.load_scores()
        self.assertEqual(len(scores), 1)
        self.assertEqual(scores[0]["id"], "test-id-1")

    def test_save_score_deduplicates_by_id(self):
        record = {
            "id": "test-id-1",
            "correct": 7,
            "total": 10,
            "accuracy": 70,
            "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        }
        self.store.save_score(record)
        updated = dict(record, correct=8, accuracy=80)
        self.store.save_score(updated)
        scores = self.store.load_scores()
        self.assertEqual(len(scores), 1)
        self.assertEqual(scores[0]["correct"], 8)

    def test_load_scores_recovers_corrupt(self):
        self.store.scores_path.write_text("{invalid", encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertEqual(self.store.load_scores(), [])

    def test_load_scores_recovers_invalid_schema(self):
        self.store.scores_path.write_text(
            json.dumps({"schema_version": 999, "scores": []}),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        self.assertEqual(self.store.load_scores(), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
